critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 9495 lines — modularization long overdue.
Dedupe endpoint's _score() uses ljust/replace string arithmetic on datetimes which is fragile; consider parsing to datetime for winner scoring.

manager-distribute silently skips leads with no update if lead_id doesn't exist/is deleted — response `total` counts even skipped updates. Consider verifying modified_count and returning skipped list.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed leads/orders and clean them up in-line via DELETE with password='delete'. Wet dedupe run was executed on live DB (safe, idempotent).
